primary_aqueous_evidence.citation: Alice D. Awtrey and Robert E. Connick, JACS73(4),1842–1843(1951)

conditions.preparation: Sealed sample equilibrated10days; acid and iodate suppress competing iodine forms. Free I2 was chemically separated in the interpretation from triiodide.

primary_aqueous_evidence.do_not_confuse: The460nm I3- coefficient975 is not the molecular I2 coefficient746. Other I3- bands are much stronger.
primary_aqueous_evidence.correction: 1954 JACS76p6417 correction changes reaction-heat signs, not the extinction table.

bounded_actionable_extension: Introduce reviewed sparse wavelength-specific molecular absorptivity records keyed by species, solvent, temperature and chemical conditions; preserve source provenance and uncertainty/scope.
Expose an exact-wavelength API whose output reports which chromophores and conditions are supported. Unknown wavelength/solvent must remain missing data, never zero.

The aqueous460nm point permits a bounded quantitative Beer–Lambert demonstration for independently established free-I2 concentration at reviewed conditions. It does not by itself permit arbitrary pure-water vessel readings because free-I2 speciation is not resolved by the current neutral inventory fallback.
Do not set the465nm grid bin equal to the460nm maximum, fabricate a smooth Gaussian, fill unknown bands with zero, or remove the full-spectrum I2 qualification.
A general dissolved-I2 instrument reading requires concentration ownership for I2/I3-/HOI and complexes, solvent-specific liquid volume, multiphase exclusion, and condition matching.
A complete appearance/color claim additionally needs reviewed absorptivities across all visible bands or digitized primary curves with interpolation provenance and uncertainty.
independent_acceptance_controls: At460nm, freeI2=1e-4M and1cm givesA=0.0746; doubling concentration or path independently doublesA.
I3- is neither assigned I2 coefficients nor counted as freeI2; sequestered starch/polyiodide is excluded.
Water and hexane are distinct keys; aqueous coefficients never transfer into an organic receiver.
Unknown465nm/525nm requests remain explicit partial coverage unless separately reviewed values exist.
Out-of-range temperature, ambiguous solvent mixture, solid iodine, unresolved iodine distribution and zero/invalid path have truthful bounded outcomes.
Adding isolated data points does not close spectral_gaps or authorize complete peak/color measurements.
